scripts.dev: pnpm run build:hook && pnpm --parallel --filter @bazhen/daemon --filter @bazhen/web run dev < /dev/null
scripts.build: pnpm run build:hook && tsc -b && pnpm --filter @bazhen/web run build
scripts.format:check: pnpm run rust-tools && cargo fmt --all --check && oxfmt --check
scripts.test:api: pnpm run build:hook && vitest run --project api
scripts.check: node --disable-warning=ExperimentalWarning scripts/check-standards.ts && node --disable-warning=ExperimentalWarning scripts/protocol-schema.ts --check && pnpm run lint && pnpm run format:check && pnpm run typecheck && pnpm run lint:rust && pnpm run deny && pnpm run test:rust && pnpm run test && pnpm run test:medium && pnpm run test:bench
scripts.test:e2e: pnpm run build:hook && pnpm --filter @bazhen/e2e-tests run test
scripts.test:medium: pnpm run build:hook && vitest run --project medium
scripts.test:bench: pnpm run build:hook && vitest run --project bench
scripts.lint:rust: pnpm run rust-tools && cargo clippy --quiet --workspace --all-targets --locked -- -D warnings
scripts.test:rust: pnpm run rust-tools && cargo nextest run --workspace --locked --status-level fail --final-status-level fail
scripts.deny: pnpm run rust-tools && cargo deny --locked check
scripts.rust-tools: cargo fmt --version >/dev/null 2>&1 && cargo clippy --version >/dev/null 2>&1 || { echo 'The Rust gates need cargo, rustfmt and clippy: install rustup, which installs the toolchain rust-toolchain.toml pins.' >&2; exit 1; }; cargo nextest --version >/dev/null 2>&1 && cargo deny --version >/dev/null 2>&1 || { echo 'The Rust gates need cargo-nextest and cargo-deny. Install them once: cargo install --locked cargo-nextest@0.9.152 cargo-deny@0.20.2' >&2; exit 1; }
